construction: P components are polarity pairs {L,L^perp} of non-isotropic lines in PG(3,q), with point block L union L^perp.
rank_pattern_verified: rank(F)=q(q^2+1)/2 and rank(W-line code)=(q+2)(q^2+1)/2 for q=3,5,7
q5_kernel: For F in F2^{156 x 325}, rank(F)=65 and dim ker(F^T)=91. The W(3,5) line incidence code has rank 91 and is contained in ker(F^T), hence equality.
q5_gauge_normal_form: Zero P-component parity iff the point-parity vector lies in the W-line incidence code. Therefore line-panel cut toggles can gauge the point-parity vector to zero.
boundary: The q=3,5,7 equalities are exhaustive finite computations. No all-odd-q rank theorem is claimed. The gauge move need not preserve leader cardinality. The minimum distance of im(F^T) and the zero-parity residual apartment sector remain open.
